text:
marie (PM): Quick design review — new Invite + Roles panel mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234. Main asks: 1) SSO toggle placement (global vs per-org), 2) roles matrix density + hover affordance, 3) audit log quick-jump (we're calling it 'Audit Finder'). Can folks skim and flag any hard blockers? :pray:

devin (Designer): skimmed it. I like the compact rows but hover-only actions for edit/delete feel risky — discoverability issues.

sam (Frontend): implementation note — hover reveal causes layout jank on Safari. Prefer a persistent micro-kebab per row or always-visible low-contrast icons.

ellie (Eng-ML): a11y note — hover-only actions are inaccessible to keyboard and screen readers. Need focusable controls and visible focus states. Role chips should be announced like: `Role: Billing Admin, selected` (or similar).

marie (PM): good calls. Proposal: persistent 3-dot menu with `aria-expanded` and a small visual weight so it doesn't dominate. Also thinking about putting the SSO toggle into the header vs inside the org settings panel — tradeoff: discoverability vs accidental changes.

jordan (Support): from support tickets: customers often ask "where's the audit log?" if it's buried under More. Suggest a top-right "Audit" quicklink (or icon) and add a keyboard quick-jump (Ctrl/Cmd+K) entry to open Audit Finder.

devin (Designer): what about linking timestamps inline in the roles table to open the Audit Finder anchored to that event? Could be powerful but might add visual noise.

sam (Frontend): linking timestamps is doable via a route param, but we should avoid heavy client work on the first pass. Also need to ensure the link degrades cleanly if audit index isn't provisioned for a customer.

a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist (quick): 1) SSO toggle must have `aria-checked` + clear label + concise help text. 2) Roles grid should be a semantic table or a list of buttons with headers. 3) Ensure logical focus order: org selector -> invite button -> roles matrix -> audit quicklink. 4) Provide skip links for long org lists.

ellie (Eng-ML): also add visible focus ring on role chips (not just outline on the row). Current Figma frames hide focus for visual polish — we should expose it.

marie (PM): copy tweak suggestion: replace "Invite team" with "Invite people" to be more inclusive and clearer. And change SSO label from "Require SSO for org" to "Enforce SSO sign-in" — clearer intent. Thoughts?

devin (Designer): agree on "Invite people". "Enforce SSO sign-in" is clearer but longer; we may need a two-line label or a shorter paraphrase. I'll test microcopy variants in the panel.

sam (Frontend): we can shorten visually and show full text in a tooltip / accessible description (`aria-describedby`) to avoid layout breaks.

jordan (Support): +1 for a contextual help link next to the toggle that sends users to tenant SSO docs. Will draft KB snippet if we finalize copy.

marie (PM): next steps: devin — update Figma with persistent micro-kebab + audit quicklink; sam — confirm implementation feasibility and fallback behavior; ellie — run keyboard + SR walkthrough; jordan — update support KB draft. Can we aim to sync on status by EOD Wed? @devin (Designer) @sam (Frontend) @ellie (Eng-ML) @jordan (Support)

devin (Designer): :thumbsup: I'll post updated frames and call out any layout tradeoffs.

sam (Frontend): I'll spike the timestamp->audit link behavior tomorrow and check Safari layout.

ellie (Eng-ML): I'll do a keyboard/run with NVDA/VoiceOver by Tue and post findings.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run Axe/VoiceOver tests before sign-off and include aria labels in the PR description.

marie (PM): thanks team — logging this as a follow-up for next design sync.
